objective: Produce an evidence-based root cause analysis of the Runtime Kernel.
objectives: Locate the implementation of the Mission Interpreter.
Locate the implementation of the Mission Ledger.
Locate the Runtime state transition implementation.
Determine where mission priority and mode are read.
Determine why the Interpreter reports NORMAL and UNKNOWN.
Determine why the Mission Ledger never leaves CREATED.
Determine whether the state transition code exists.
If it exists, explain why it is never executed.
If it does not exist, identify the exact missing Runtime capability.
Produce an evidence-based engineering report identifying every file that must be modified to repair the Runtime Kernel.
